name: Minds 8: pilferage against how long a seen cache is remembered
description: The share of caches pilfered per tick (pilferage_rate: caches pilfered ÷ caches at the tick's start; window_mean, ticks 100–200, the first winter) in watch-winter's world (theft-winter's winter, every agent a watcher, no stumbling on caches, so every pilfer is a raid on a seen cache) against the ticks a seen cache stays remembered (watching.span): 1, 3, 7 or 13. Heinrich and Pepper's ravens recovered seen caches the next day and none at 14 days; 7 is the default, about midway. Seeds 1–20.

x.label: Ticks a seen cache is remembered
